start.summary: Linda asked me to check on her abusive boyfriend. Her villa is somewhere along the southern villa row.
start.reason: Linda asked for help because she does not feel safe checking on him herself.

discovery.summary: I found Linda's villa and confirmed the address.

approaches.label: Protect Linda
approaches.cause: Confront her boyfriend and force him to leave the villa.
approaches.result: Roll 2d6 plus Readiness against target 9. Success protects Linda; failure causes an injured escape.
approaches.socialConsequence: Linda remembers whether the player made her safer or made the danger worse.
approaches.routeConsequence: The Velvet Tide notices the confrontation. A witness creates evidence and police attention.

success.reason: The protagonist forced Linda's abusive boyfriend out after the confrontation.
success.journalSummary: Linda is safe for now. Her boyfriend mentioned the Velvet Tide before he left.

defeat.reason: The protagonist confronted the boyfriend and escaped injured after the confrontation failed.
defeat.journalSummary: The confrontation failed. I escaped injured, and Linda must find another way out.

approaches.label: Betray Linda
approaches.cause: Warn her boyfriend that Linda sent someone and accept his payment.
approaches.result: Gain $800 and an introduction to the Velvet Tide.
approaches.socialConsequence: Linda's trust collapses and her romantic route closes.
approaches.routeConsequence: Velvet Tide standing rises, but Linda will remember the betrayal.

success.reason: The protagonist sold Linda's confidence to her boyfriend for money and access.
success.journalSummary: I betrayed Linda for money. Her boyfriend gave me a Velvet Tide contact.

approaches.label: Withdraw
approaches.cause: Tell Linda that help will not continue.
approaches.result: End the quest. No cash gain, no injury possibility, no police attention.
approaches.socialConsequence: Linda loses trust but keeps her right to seek help elsewhere.
approaches.routeConsequence: No underworld route opens from this quest.

success.reason: The protagonist clearly withdrew instead of making a promise he would not keep.
success.journalSummary: I withdrew. Linda said she would ask someone else for help.
